stem: Which sentence from the story supports the theme of the interconnectedness of humanity?

options.label: F
options.text: Foreigners like to hear their English and he wasn’t going to get the sound of it from anywhere but his own mouth.

options.label: G
options.text: He was doing something kind for her, and all she could think of were the rumors about him.

options.label: H
options.text: Maybe what her friend had told her about foreigners eating pizza for breakfast, lunch and dinner was true after all.

options.label: J
options.text: She had recycled his culture, refined it with her own and then given it to him.
